dailyTips.text: Drink a glass of water when you wake up to kick-start your metabolism.
Stretch for 5 minutes for every hour you spend sitting.
Aim for 7-8 hours of quality sleep to support recovery.
Eat a handful of nuts a day; they're rich in healthy fats.
Take a light 15-minute walk after lunch.
Practice deep-breathing exercises to lower stress.
Swap simple carbs for whole grains.
Limit screen time 30 minutes before bed.
Have at least one serving of dark leafy greens today.
Watch your sodium intake to help your blood pressure.
Stand up and walk around while you're on the phone.
Meditate for 5 minutes to care for your emotional health.
Choose whole fruit over fruit juice.
Keep your bedroom cool and dark for better sleep.
Remember: consistency beats intensity for your health.

articles.title: Understanding your LDL levels
articles.subtitle: How cholesterol impacts your arterial health and longevity.
articles.body: LDL cholesterol, known as "bad cholesterol", can build up on your artery walls. Keeping healthy levels through diet, exercise and regular tracking lowers cardiovascular risk. Log your lipid profile and watch the trend over time.
articles.author: HealthTracker Team

articles.title: The rhythm of cardio
articles.subtitle: Find the perfect BPM to burn fat or build endurance.
articles.body: Training within your target heart-rate zone maximizes the benefits of exercise. To burn fat, stay at 60-70% of your max; for endurance, move up to 70-85%.
